result.summary: Replaces standard Python assert statements with test framework comparison helpers in the HTTP interface functional test. The changes introduce assert_greater_than and assert_greater_than_or_equal where custom assertion messages were not present.
result.problem: When bare assert comparisons fail in interface_http.py, the test failure output does not display the actual and expected values being compared, making test failure diagnostics slower.
evidence: Author description cites a follow-up review suggestion on merged PR #36324: 'Suggested in review of #36324: https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36324#discussion_r4102111525'
result.scope_notes: Very small change replacing assertions across four lines in a single functional test.
result.card: This PR updates assertions in interface_http.py to use test framework helpers assert_greater_than and assert_greater_than_or_equal. Bare assertions do not display the compared values on failure, hindering test debugging. The change follows up on a review suggestion from PR #36324.

risk.why: Touches only assertion helper usage in a functional test, which at worst could cause false test failures.
